name: cable unilateral step up
description: A single leg step up with cable resistance that builds leg strength and balance one side at a time.
instructions: Face a box with the cable handle held at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel and stand up straight on the box.
Lower your trailing foot back to the floor slowly.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
